events.title: Tupac Shakur Shooting Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, legendary rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the impact and legacy of Tupac Shakur, 30 years on from the tragic incident in Las Vegas.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the world lost guitar icon Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Paying tribute to the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Celebration
angles.copy: Walk down memory lane with us as we celebrate the anniversary of The Beatles' legendary 'Abbey Road' album.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the rock icon Chrissie Hynde! Still sounding incredible.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was first released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since 'Imagine' landed in the UK charts. Still as powerful and relevant as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember when music went truly portable? Happy anniversary to the original iPod, launched 25 years ago today.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks Global James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Celebration
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Sending a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Celebration
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' sprawling 'White Album' – a masterpiece of diverse sounds.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Forever a champion. Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the one and only Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Celebration
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! Celebrating the anniversary of The Beatles' influential 'Rubber Soul'.

events.title: John Lennon's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message continue to inspire generations, 46 years after his passing.
